messages:
Mira: dropped a quick set of tweaks to the embeddings preview + export in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz-embeddings (Frames: PreviewCompact, ExportModal). main asks: clearer export CTA, score readability, and keyboard fixes.

Jon: nice. tiny nit: toolbar CTA currently just 'Export'  can we make it 'Download results ▾' with quick items for 'Visible', 'Selection', 'Sample (10 rows)'? avoids accidental full exports.

Elise: +1. copy for confirmation modal: "Prepare a file for download? File will be ready shortly. Est. size: 2.3 MB." add link text: "Download now" and small expiry note.

Toshi: accessibility: score color alone isn't enough. show numeric score next to pill. make pills focusable and include aria-label="Score: 0.82 normalized". ensure modal Exports supports Enter to confirm and Escape to cancel.

Mira: good. also request: add "include full text" checkbox in modal (default: snippet 250 chars) and a toggled "compact CSV" option (no model/dim).

Jon: export rule: if rows > 5000 OR est_size > 5MB -> enqueue server job (Queued -> Processing -> Ready -> Failed). UI: show job card in Notifications with ETA and link. small sample preview available immediately.

Elise: CSV headers: prefer snake_case for exports for compatibility: vector_id,batch_name,text_snippet,raw_score,norm_score,model,embedding_dim. add a JSONL option for long text payloads.

Toshi: keyboard flow: arrow keys navigate rows, Space toggles selection, Enter opens preview. preview should trap focus and have aria-labelledby. add aria-live polite region announcing "Export job started" and "Export ready".

design-bot: analytics: track export_requested, export_confirmed, export_sample_downloaded, export_completed with props { format, rows, est_size_bytes, job_id }. Recommend adding export_method (client|server).

Mira: action items: Jon - CTA dropdown design, Elise - modal copy + sample text snippet, Toshi - keyboard/ARIA annotations, design-bot - add analytics props. follow-up Fri 11am for PR review.

Jon: will attach a tiny CSV example in follow-up.

Elise: I'll test NVDA/VoiceOver flows and report any surprises.

Toshi: quick accessibility checklist added to the Figma file comments.

Mira: thanks all! :raised_hands:
